body:
New named season pilot cold open. Tyler and Hana wake in a decommissioned 1986 Iceland server room; a printer holds the LO-language source for the Mecha Cube; reading it resolves the long-PENDING Bird Correction; Hana talks Tyler out of reading it and he feeds the printout back into the printer. Framed as the Duck's dream, played in French until the Duck wakes with no memory of French. Files: episodes/vh01_valhanna_coldopen.md (new), EPISODES.md (registry + season section), README.md (Bird Correction footnote), CHANGELOG.md.

⚓ ☃
title: VALHANNA cold open: VH01 'Je Ne Sais Quoi'
